summary.en: Get a license to import goods into or export goods out of Ethiopia from the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration. You need an existing trade license and TIN first — this permit adds import/export as an activity.
summary.am: ከንግድና ክልላዊ ውህደት ሚኒስቴር ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ለማስገባት ወይም ለማስወጣት ፈቃድ ያግኙ። መጀመሪያ የንግድ ፈቃድና ታቢ ሊኖርዎት ይገባል።

title.en: Confirm your trade license covers the activity

description.en: Import/export permits are issued on top of a valid trade license whose activity list includes importing or exporting. If your current license doesn't list it, amend the trade license first at your sub-city trade office (activity addition).
description.am: የመግቢያ/መውጫ ፈቃድ የሚሰጠው ንግድ ማስመጣትን ወይም ማስወጣትን በሚያካትት ህጋዊ የንግድ ፈቃድ ላይ ነው።

responsible_office.en: Sub-city Trade and Industry Development Office
responsible_office.am: የክፍለ ከተማ ንግድና ኢንዱስትሪ ልማት ጽህፈት ቤት

official_timeline.en: 1–3 working days (only if an amendment is needed)

title.en: Get a TIN and tax clearance

description.en: Your business needs an active TIN with no outstanding tax obligations. Request a tax clearance certificate from the Ministry of Revenues — most import/export applications require it, and customs will demand it at clearance time anyway.
description.am: ንግድዎ ያለ የቀረ ግብር ንቁ ታቢ ቁጥር ሊኖረው ይገባል።

title.en: Identify your commodity category and restrictions

description.en: Check whether the goods you plan to import/export are restricted, require a separate permit (pharmaceuticals, food, arms, chemicals, plants/animals), or are banned. The Ministry of Trade publishes the list; customs can also confirm. Restricted goods need extra approvals before the license is issued.
description.am: ለማስገባት/ለማስወጣት ያቀዱት ሸቀጦች የተገደቡ፣ የተለየ ፈቃድ የሚፈልጉ ወይም የተከለከሉ መሆናቸውን ያረጋግጡ።

responsible_office.en: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration (MoTRI) — trade facilitation directorate

official_timeline.en: 1–2 working days (research; no office visit usually needed)

label.en: List of goods to be imported/exported with HS codes (if known)

description.en: Assemble the application: the import/export license application form, trade license, TIN, tax clearance, ID copies, photos, and a description of the business and the goods. For companies, include the memorandum of association and board resolution.
description.am: የማመልከቻ ቅጹን፣ የንግድ ፈቃድ፣ ታቢ፣ የግብር ማረጋገጫና ፎቶዎችን ያዘጋጁ።

responsible_office.en: Yourself (no office visit needed for this step)
responsible_office.am: እርስዎ ራስዎ (ለዚህ እርምጃ ቢሮ መሄድ አያስፈልግም)

label.en: Memorandum of association + board resolution (companies only)

title.en: Submit at MoTRI and pay the license fee

description.en: Submit the file at the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration (the import/export licensing desk). Pay the license fee at the designated bank/cashier and attach the receipt. You'll get a reference number to track the review.
description.am: ፋይሉን በንግድና ክልላዊ ውህደት ሚኒስቴር የመግቢያ/መውጫ ፈቃድ ዴስክ ያቅርቡ።

responsible_office.en: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration — import/export licensing desk
responsible_office.am: የንግድና ክልላዊ ውህደት ሚኒስቴር — የፈቃድ ዴስክ

description.en: The Ministry reviews the file and issues the license (or asks for corrections). Collect it in person with your ID and receipt. Keep copies for customs — you'll present the license at every border clearance.
description.am: ሚኒስቴሩ ፋይሉን ገምግሞ ፈቃዱን ይሰጣል ወይም እርማት ይጠይቃል።

responsible_office.en: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration — issuance desk
responsible_office.am: የንግድና ክልላዊ ውህደት ሚኒስቴር — የመስጫ ዴስክ

common_rejection_reasons.en: Trade license does not include import/export activity
Outstanding tax obligations — no tax clearance issued
Goods category requires a separate permit that wasn't obtained
Restricted or banned goods attempted under a general license
Company documents (memorandum, resolution) missing or expired
common_rejection_reasons.am: የኩባንያ ሰነዶች የሉም ወይም ጊዜያቸው አልፏል

common_rejection_reasons.en: Inconsistent details between trade license, TIN and application

notes.en: The import/export license is a federal process — filed at MoTRI in Addis Ababa regardless of where your business is registered. Addis residents can walk in; businesses from other regions usually send a representative or use a licensed customs clearing agent.
notes.am: የመግቢያ/መውጫ ፈቃድ የፌደራል ሂደት ነው — ንግድዎ የተመዘገበበት ቦታ ምንም ይሁን ምን በአዲስ አበባ በሚኒስቴሩ ይቀርባል።

notes.en: Federal process filed at MoTRI Addis Ababa. Local support: the Amhara Region Trade Bureau in Bahir Dar can pre-check your file and confirm commodity restrictions before you travel.
notes.am: የፌደራል ሂደት በአዲስ አበባ በሚኒስቴሩ ይቀርባል። በባህር ዳር የአማራ ክልል የንግድ ቢሮ ፋይሉን አስቀድሞ ማጣራት ይችላል።

responsible_office.en: Amhara Region Trade Bureau, Bahir Dar branch

notes.en: Dire Dawa is a federal city and a trade gateway (Ethio-Djibouti railway corridor) — many importers register here. The trade license step runs through the Dire Dawa city trade office; the import/export license itself is still filed federally in Addis.
notes.am: ድሬ ዳዋ የፌደራል ከተማና የንግድ መግቢያ በር ናት።

responsible_office.en: Dire Dawa City Trade and Industry Development Office

notes.en: Federal process filed at MoTRI Addis Ababa. Local support: the Tigray Region Trade Bureau in Mekelle can pre-check your file and confirm commodity restrictions before you travel.
notes.am: የፌደራል ሂደት በአዲስ አበባ በሚኒስቴሩ ይቀርባል። በመቀሌ የትግራይ ክልል የንግድ ቢሮ ፋይሉን አስቀድሞ ማጣራት ይችላል።

responsible_office.en: Tigray Region Trade Bureau, Mekelle branch

notes.en: Federal process filed at MoTRI Addis Ababa. The Oromia Region Trade Bureau, Jimma branch handles the underlying trade license and can confirm commodity restrictions.
notes.am: የፌደራል ሂደት በአዲስ አበባ በሚኒስቴሩ ይቀርባል። በጅማ የኦሮሚያ ክልል የንግድ ቢሮ የንግድ ፈቃዱን ይይዛል።

responsible_office.en: Oromia Region Trade Bureau, Jimma branch

notes.en: Federal process filed at MoTRI Addis Ababa. The Amhara Region Trade Bureau, Gondar branch handles the underlying trade license.
notes.am: የፌደራል ሂደት በአዲስ አበባ በሚኒስቴሩ ይቀርባል። በጎንደር የአማራ ክልል የንግድ ቢሮ የንግድ ፈቃዱን ይይዛል።

responsible_office.en: Amhara Region Trade Bureau, Gondar branch

notes.en: Federal process filed at MoTRI Addis Ababa. The Oromia Region Trade Bureau, Adama branch handles the underlying trade license; being close to the corridor, Adama firms often use customs clearing agents.
notes.am: የፌደራል ሂደት በአዲስ አበባ በሚኒስቴሩ ይቀርባል። በአዳማ የኦሮሚያ ክልል የንግድ ቢሮ የንግድ ፈቃዱን ይይዛል።

responsible_office.en: Oromia Region Trade Bureau, Adama branch
